title: Jim Semivan opened the door for McGwier's visit to Bledsoe
summary: Bob McGwier tells of Jim Semivan opened the door for McGwier's visit to Bledsoe, about undated at North Carolina, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and he told me while I was there that Jim sovan said oh yeah you should let Bob in this should be interesting

plain: An engineer described as a CIA contractor, Bob McGwier, tells of visiting Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man whose strange experiences are told in a book called UFO of God. McGwier says Bledsoe told him during the visit that a man named Jim Semivan had said, "oh yeah, you should let Bob in, this should be interesting." If true, it would suggest someone behind the scenes was quietly deciding who got access to Bledsoe.
